        4.  One queen per region.
        5.  Queens cannot touch (orthogonally or diagonally). This means if a queen is at $(r, c)$, no other queen can be at $(r\pm1, c\pm1)$ or $(r\pm1, c)$. Since one per row/col is already required, the "touching" constraint specifically forbids adjacent rows having columns differing by 0 (already covered by col rule) or 1. So $|c_i - c_{i+1}| > 1$.
